whatIsNew: PROG-01 — the publishing step writes a client progress page from the record into each publish, at `progress/` on the site: v4 by phase, every v4 item, the record's history and the rest; plain names in `progress/names.json`; loads nothing from another site, by pull request (2026-11-25)
whatToTry: After the merge and the next publish, open https://djdaojones.github.io/route-plotter/progress/
Check the phase bars and the item table against the backlog.
Focus the chart and use the arrow keys, or open "Show the chart's numbers".
Run Actions → Publish → Run workflow (mode publish) twice in a row: the second run should find nothing new.
